task_summary: Expanded plagiarism checker upload capabilities to accept both Word (.docx) documents and PDF files up to 25 MB across server middleware and client UI dropzone. Fixed unrendered/invisible text in document viewers caused by dark mode CSS color inversion on authentic white paper sheets by inoculating docx-preview, annotated-text, and [data-paper-sheet] surfaces with dark charcoal (#0f172a). Added validateDocumentFile middleware with magic-byte and ZIP extension detection, updated extractText for docx/msword handling, enhanced DropZone and ArchivePlagiarismCheckerPage for DOCX acceptance, and updated PlagiarismReportPage and index.css with high-contrast text rendering. Passed 5/5 server unit tests (validateDocumentFile), 16/16 client unit tests (SophisticatedDocumentViewer & PlagiarismReportPage), 45/45 server integration tests, 204/182 endpoint parity (UNMATCHED_COUNT=0), 60/60 agentic validation checks, and full Playwright visual feedback loop in light and dark modes across desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844).
